# printingtask • WhatsApp Business CRM & Support Hub

> An automated AI customer support, CRM, and broadcast notification system for printingtask services.

## Overview
printingtask WhatsApp Business CRM enables automated AI conversations via Google Gemini, appointment booking, custom order tracking, bulk promotional broadcasts within Meta's 24-hour customer service window, and multi-agent customer support.

## Key Features
- **AI Auto-Reply:** Powered by Google Gemini with customizable personas (Printing Expert, Task Assistant, Friendly Support).
- **Meta 24h Free Window Tracker:** Real-time countdown tracking customer service windows to ensure ₹0 Meta messaging fees.
- **Bulk Notification Sender:** Send personalized broadcasts with variable interpolation (`{{name}}`, `{{phone}}`, `{{service}}`).
- **Order & Booking Management:** Convert WhatsApp inquiries directly into scheduled service bookings.
